svg.text: PSIR optional — theory statecraft at home, theory statecraft abroad
near-total GS-2 overlap: the compounding optional for polity + IR aspirants
PAPER 1 — THEORY + INDIAN POLITICS
Approaches: normative · empirical · feminist · post-colonial
State theories · justice: Rawls – Sen – Nozick triangle
Liberty · equality · rights · democracy (deliberative turn)
Power: Lukes' three faces · ideologies (liberal→multicultural)
India: national-movement streams (Gandhi · Ambedkar · Periyar · Lohia)
Party system phases · federalism bargains (GST-era frictions)
Judiciary/PIL · 73rd-74th · movements · identity politics
style: thinker-density 2–3 per answer, applied to India
PAPER 2 — COMPARATIVE + IR + INDIA-WORLD
Realism: Morgenthau → Waltz (structural) → offensive/defensive
Liberal interdependence · democratic peace · English school
Constructivism: Wendt — "anarchy is what states make of it"
IPE: Bretton Woods · trade regimes · globalisation debates
India-world: Panchsheel→NAM→strategic autonomy→multi-alignment
Neighbours ×6 dossiers · US/Russia/EU/Japan · QUAD/BRICS/G20
BIMSTEC/SCO/ASEAN coupling · UN reform case · climate diplomacy
style: substance + structure — never newspaper chronology
TWELVE-WEEK FIRST PASS
wk 1-3 theory · wk 4-5 Indian politics · wk 6-7 comparative+IR theory · wk 8-9 IPE/concepts · wk 10-11 India-and-world dossiers · wk 12 PYQ map + current file
watch: comparative block under-taught — schedule it; margins need theory-density in a large pool
